prospects.thesis: SMCI is the leading provider of AI-optimized server and liquid-cooling infrastructure, directly monetizing hyperscaler capex on Blackwell-class GPU deployments. The stock has ripped +30.6% in a month yet still trades at a remarkable 0.7x sales, and bullish options plus institutional flow confirm smart money is re-engaging post-audit overhang. Near-term catalysts include DLC (direct liquid cooling) volume ramp and expanded Malaysia/Taiwan capacity coming online.

GitLab's Duo AI code assistant and end-to-end DevSecOps platform are gaining enterprise traction as competitors like Copilot force customers to consolidate on unified pipelines. The +37.8% one-month move signals a breakout on accelerating Duo Pro seat adoption, with bullish options and institutional accumulation confirming conviction. At 7.9x sales the multiple is reasonable versus other AI-native SaaS names, and the upcoming quarter should showcase Duo attach rates.

CACI is a pure-play on defense software, SIGINT, and electronic warfare — exactly the higher-margin tech content the Pentagon is prioritizing in FY26 budgeting. Momentum is exceptional (+20.4% 1M) against a defense group that's been flat-to-down, and bullish options flow suggests the market anticipates strong contract awards. At 1.4x sales with expanding EW backlog, valuation still leaves room even after the run.

Qualcomm offers the most attractive risk/reward in large-cap semis at 4.1x sales, with edge-AI silicon (Snapdragon X for PCs, auto compute wins) diversifying away from Apple modem risk. Bullish options and institutional positioning point to accumulation ahead of the AI PC refresh cycle and continued auto design-win momentum. The modest +7.7% 1M move means we're not chasing an extended chart.

HII is the sole builder of US nuclear aircraft carriers and a key Virginia/Columbia-class sub contractor — a monopoly asset benefiting from the Navy's 30-year shipbuilding plan and AUKUS submarine funding. The -9.6% pullback creates a contrarian entry against bullish options and institutional support, offering a hedge against the momentum-heavy rest of the list. At 0.9x sales with multi-decade backlog visibility, downside looks limited.
